tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Basic facts about AtlantFlow AC & Heat: legal and trade name, Florida license, founding year, address, phone, email, website, brands serviced, certifications. Use for 'who are they / how do I contact them / are they licensed'.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List the HVAC services AtlantFlow offers (AC repair, replacement, maintenance plan, heating, mini-splits, thermostats, indoor air quality, commercial HVAC and refrigeration, emergency service) with a short description and page URL for each.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether AtlantFlow serves a location. Returns status 'served' (primary service area), 'ask' (listed or nearby but availability must be confirmed by phone) or 'not_served' (outside Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade). Give a ZIP whenever possible.

tools.name: get_hours_and_emergency
tools.description: AtlantFlow's hours: whether regular service hours are open at a given moment (default now), whether the $149 emergency call fee applies at that time, and the rules for Sundays and nights. Calls are answered 24/7.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Published AtlantFlow prices (diagnostic, emergency call fee, tune-up, maintenance plan, financing) plus historical invoice statistics by job type (median and middle-half range, number of jobs). Only groups with 20+ jobs are published; no per-city prices. Statistics describe past invoices, not a quot

tools.name: estimate_replacement_cost
tools.description: Ballpark cost range for a full residential AC system replacement in AtlantFlow's service area, from the company's own closed invoices (median and middle-half range with sample size). NOT a quote: the final price needs a free in-home estimate. Returns no estimate for ZIPs outside Palm Beach/Broward/M

tools.name: get_membership_and_financing
tools.description: AtlantFlow's maintenance plan (single plan, $200/year per system, two visits a year), the single-visit tune-up ($149), and financing (from $89/month, $0 down on approved credit), plus the warranty rules.

tools.name: get_second_opinion_info
tools.description: The free second-opinion service for homeowners who received an AC replacement quote from another company: what is covered, that it is free, and how to ask for it.

tools.name: get_reviews_summary
tools.description: Customer rating summary: Google rating and review count and Thumbtack rating, each with the date it was checked. Use when asked about reputation. Counts change over time; the date shows how fresh they are.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: How to reach or book AtlantFlow: phone (answered 24/7), the website callback/booking form, the contact page, and the request_service tool.

tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Ask AtlantFlow to call a customer back about service. ONLY call when the person explicitly asked to be contacted and gave their name, phone and ZIP. Side effect: creates a lead in AtlantFlow's Housecall Pro CRM and notifies the office; nothing is deleted or overwritten. Not idempotent but protected:

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search AtlantFlow's published HVAC articles. Use when a homeowner asks why their AC does something (not cooling, freezing up, strange noises, high humidity, no heat) or how to troubleshoot or maintain a system in South Florida. Returns ranked articles with title, URL, summary and date; call get_arti

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read the full text of one AtlantFlow article (troubleshooting steps, causes, typical South Florida advice) by URL or id. Use after search_articles or list_articles, to answer a homeowner's how-to or why-is-my-AC-doing-X question. Includes the publication date, the license line and a call-to-action.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List AtlantFlow's published HVAC articles, newest first, optionally filtered by topic. Use to browse what guidance exists (AC not cooling, freezing, noises, humidity, heating) before answering a South Florida homeowner's question.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_articles" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List AtlantFlow's published HVAC articles, newest first, optionally filtered by topic. Use to browse what guidance exists (AC not cooling, freezing, noises, hum…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_info, get_services, get_reviews_summary, search_articles, get_article · Private data: get_company_info, get_booking_options · Public sink: get_company_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_info, get_services, get_reviews_summary, search_articles, get_article · Private data: get_company_info, get_booking_options · Public sink: get_company_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
